neighbours.label: ' the' in a sentence about astronauts or crewed spaceflight, right after a preposition or verb of place, where a spacecraft or destination is about to be named (to the, aboard the)

notes: Card: ' the' x23 of the top 32, before International Space Station, Mir, Tiangong; ' Space' x4. Probes: 'aboard the' 0.906, 'fly to the moon' 0.703, 'astronauts returned to the village' 0.468 and 'visited the White House' 0.301, so the space-traveller context drives it even for an earthly destination; 'tourists will fly to the island' 0.042 and 'crew walked to the launch pad' 0.040.
